home_hero.badge: Live on SharePoint, Microsoft Teams & SharePoint Mobile
home_hero.headline: Send from SharePoint. Signed back into SharePoint.
home_hero.lead: SharePoint electronic signatures built for Australian law. Send PDFs and interactive proposals straight from SharePoint or Teams — clients sign in seconds with no Microsoft login, and the signed copy lands back in the original folder.

unmetered_banner.headline: Unlimited, unmetered envelopes for every user.
unmetered_banner.body: No per-envelope fees, no surprise overage bills, and no per-seat metering. Every team member can send as many agreements as they need — bounded only by your standard Microsoft 365 Outlook sending limits.
unmetered_banner.fine_print: The only monthly allowance is 100 Transform with Claude PDF-to-HTML proposal transforms on Tier 3 (custom allowances available on Custom plans).

pricing.tier1_summary: Core SharePoint & Teams e-signing for everyday agreements.
pricing.tier2_summary: Multi-party routing for commercial & internal approvals.
pricing.tier3_summary: Adds optional Transform with Claude Document Studio.
pricing.custom_summary: White-label branding and custom Claude Studio capacity.

cta_band.headline: Stop downloading, re-uploading and chasing signatures.
cta_band.body: See Send & Sign running inside your own SharePoint — from document pick to signed copy back in the same folder — in a 20-minute demo.
